env BOLERO_MODULE=off
[short] skip

# Set up fresh BOLERO_CACHE.
env BOLERO_CACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $BOLERO_CACHE

# Building trivial non-main package should run compiler the first time.
bolero build -x lib.go
stderr '(compile|gccgo)( |\.exe).*lib\.go'

# ... but not again ...
bolero build -x lib.go
! stderr '(compile|gccgo)( |\.exe).*lib\.go'

# ... unless we use -a.
bolero build -a -x lib.go
stderr '(compile|gccgo)( |\.exe)'

-- lib.go --
package lib
